messages.content: I'm Mnx, the Queen of your Hive. I plan your tasks and send Bees to do them.
A Bee is a small helper with one job, like searching the web, watching a price or using your phone. Each Bee has its own Cell on your server.
Can you work while my phone is off?
Yes. The Hive runs on your server, so your Bees keep working 24/7 even when your phone is off.
Will you pay for things without asking?
Never. Anything that spends money or sends a message waits for your tap first.
A Cell is a Bee's own workspace: a container with a terminal, browser storage, files and jobs that keep running all the time.
Open the Cloud Bee, pick the chat fine-tune recipe, upload example chats and press Train. I learn from them and you can run the new version right away.
On your own server, or on any GPU server you connect to the Cloud Bee. Your model and data stay yours.
Vanakkam! Naan Mnx. Ungalukku eppadi udhava mudiyum?
